title: Crosley — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Crosley.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Everyday Basics." Value tier. Crosley is a value brand distributed by Whirlpool Corporation — basic appliances at the absolute lowest price point, sold through independent dealers. Below Amana in the Whirlpool hierarchy.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Extreme budget needs through independent dealers. Rental properties.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Crosley:

• Lowest Whirlpool-family pricing

• Independent dealer channel

• Basic reliable performance

• Parts available through Whirlpool network

• Fills the absolute entry-level need
